verdict.rationale: WezTerm provides CLI/mux scripting and headless control (spawn, send-text, get-text) that could be used as building blocks, but there is no evidence of a scheduler, trigger system, or persistent background automation framework that runs autonomously without an external orchestrator invoking it. missing for 10: any documented scheduling/trigger mechanism, autonomous background job execution, or agent-loop capability distinct from manual/CLI-invoked scripting.
